items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: He's a very well-known entertainer, and Buzzy's worked with him as a, you know, as an accompanist.

ctx.x: Lynam, I think. Lynam, I think. Like a Lynam.

Lynam, Tommy Lynam. He's a very well-known entertainer, and Buzzy's worked with him as a, you know, as an accompanist. In fact, he wouldn't have anyone else Buzzy with him. But that's been in recent years now, I'd say in the past 10 years or so. Now, I don't know, I can't remember some of the names that he worked with before that. But he's accompanied pretty near every vocalist in the Wallens, and all the big clubs. He worked in all the big clubs like Club Forest and The Silver Slipper, and The Silver Slipper was…
